summary:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive digital archive dedicated to preserving the stories and achievements of spacecraft and robotic explorers that have completed their missions or become inactive. Inspired by humanity's journey beyond Earth, the project transforms historical NASA mission information into an engaging educational experience.

Users can explore featured missions, view authentic NASA photographs, discover important mission milestones and learn about the scientific contributions of iconic explorers, including the Apollo Lunar Rover, Mars Opportunity Rover and Ingenuity Helicopter.

By combining interactive storytelling, historical mission information and NASA's publicly available resources, Echoes of Exploration makes space exploration more accessible and engaging. The project aims to preserve the legacy of past missions, inspire curiosity about space science and remind future generations that even when a mission ends, its discoveries continue to shape humanity's future.
details:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive web-based educational archive that preserves and showcases the legacy of historical space exploration missions.

The platform features three space explorers: the Apollo Lunar Rover, Mars Opportunity Rover and Ingenuity Mars Helicopter. Each explorer has a dedicated information page containing historical photographs, mission descriptions, important dates, achievements and mission outcomes.

Users can browse the explorer gallery, explore individual mission stories and navigate a chronological timeline of important events. The interface is designed with a cinematic space-inspired theme to create an engaging and accessible learning experience.

The project uses publicly available NASA mission information and imagery as its primary data resources. HTML, CSS and JavaScript are used to develop the website, while GitHub Pages provides public hosting.

Our creative approach focuses on storytelling rather than presenting scientific information as plain text. By transforming historical mission records into an interactive digital experience, we aim to preserve the legacy of space exploration, promote STEM education and inspire future generations to continue exploring beyond Earth.

The project is designed to be lightweight, accessible, educational and expandable, allowing additional missions and historical explorers to be included in the future.
